description:
FILED s1202 (Opus, 2026-09-20) while #1202 gave `p-load-extension` the module-fasl
cache.  #1202's design question (5), answered by measurement and then NOT taken in
that batch.

WHAT #1202 SHIPPED.  An extension (cl/pcl-pack.lisp, -mro, -warnings, -xs) is now
compiled to <cache>/ext/<name>-<content stem>-<runtime identity>.fasl on first use
and loaded from there afterwards.  The PER-USER cache is the right home for a
checkout, where the tree is the user's own.

WHAT IS LEFT.  `tools/install-pcl` compiles the runtime core AT INSTALL -- "the XS
model, never at first use" -- and writes it INTO THE TREE (<root>/pcl.core).  The
extension fasl is not built there, so on an INSTALLED tree the first program that
packs pays the compile, once per user:

    cl/pcl-pack.lisp   compile-file  4.70 s      (s1202, this box, quiet)
    the same file as a fasl, loaded  0.004 s
    as text (what it was before)     4.26 s

For a single-user `~/.local` install that is one run's worth, the same as a
checkout, and it is why this was not taken.  For the SHARED shape the install
matrix covers -- /opt/pcl installed by root, users each with their own cache
(tools/t/install-container.t) -- EVERY user pays it, and root's own prebuild helps
nobody, because the artifact lands in root's cache.

THE SHAPE, if it is taken.  Not "run pack once in the installer's self-test" (that
fills the INSTALLING user's cache only).  Give the loader a second, READ-ONLY place
to look, in the install tree beside pcl.core:

    <root>/ext/<name>-<content stem>-<runtime identity>.fasl

built by tools/install-pcl right after the core, consulted by %p-ext-fasl-path
BEFORE the user cache and never written there.  The key is unchanged, so a tree
entry and a cache entry can never disagree; a user whose runtime identity differs
(they will not, on an installed tree) simply misses and builds their own.

COST/BAR: +4.7 s to every install (against the core's ~60 s), a second lookup on
the extension path (one probe-file, paid once per extension per run), two rows in
tools/t/install-pcl.t and one in tools/t/ext-fasl.t (a tree entry is used and the
user cache stays empty).  docs/caching.md section 4 and docs/extensions.md say
where the entries live and would both need the second location.
subject: Pre-build the compiled EXTENSIONS into the install TREE, like the core -- a shared /opt/pcl install makes every user pay the 4.7 s pack compile once
